Hi Luis — thanks for the quick upload and the bank letter. A couple of clarifications so we can move PO #84512 out of hold: 

1) Tax form type: The W-8BEN-E indicates foreign status. If Fresh Hardware is a US person for tax purposes (uses a US EIN for US-source payments), we need a completed W-9 rather than a W-8BEN-E. Please confirm whether Fresh Hardware Inc. is US tax-resident for payments to Redwood.

2) EIN formatting & verification: When you send the W-9, please ensure the EIN is entered exactly as issued (we run IRS TIN matching). If the EIN on the W-9 and the EIN shown on the bank letter differ in any character, the PO will remain on hold. Provide a supporting document (CP575 or bank letter) if the name/EIN pairing is nonstandard.

3) Signatory authority: If the person signing is not listed on the bank letter, please include an authorization (signed) showing they are an authorized signer.

4) DocuSign: We can accept an e-signed W-9 via DocuSign. If you prefer, here is an embedded signing link we use: https://app.docusign.com/link/embedded?envelopeId=abc123.

For now I've placed PO #84512 in "Pending Tax Verification." Typical SLA is 3–5 business days from receipt of a clean W-9 + supporting evidence.

Subject: Internal: Fresh Hardware (PO #84512) — next steps if EIN fails TIN match

Team — quick internal note on Fresh Hardware: Luis has provided a signed W-9 and a bank letter; he also indicated the EIN contains a hyphen (12-3456789). Our accounts system performs IRS TIN name matching and will fail if characters don't match exactly. If the TIN check fails, please follow this order of escalation:

1) Reply to vendor asking for a CP575 or an IRS official letter showing the EIN (preferred).
2) If CP575 unavailable, request a bank account verification letter on bank letterhead that explicitly states the taxpayer name and EIN.
3) As a last resort accept a voided check + a signed letter from an officer of Fresh Hardware certifying the EIN, but route the PO as "Conditional Payment" and flag for finance review.

Action items:
- Monica: run the TIN match when the w9_updated_signed.pdf lands in the vendor folder (PROC-4127). Mark result in the procurement ticket and attach the vendor-provided file.
- Hiro: if TIN fails, send Luis the CP575 request language below (I pasted a short template in the ticket) and offer the DocuSign link for re-signing.

Procurement note: we can create a provisional PO in Coupa with "Pending Tax" status to reserve the budget but we will not send payment instructions until verification is cleared.

Laura Bennett
